name: noise
description: 6 passages (12 sentences) of methods, statistics and clinical text full of non-gene acronyms, written to stress the gene-guessing heuristic. Almost no gold entities: false positives here are wrongly guessed genes. Scored once and NOT tuned to.
guidelines: Annotation guidelines: entities are named human genes/gene products (HGNC symbols and common aliases), diseases, pathways/biological processes, organisms, drugs/chemicals and rs-numbered SNPs. Lab reagents, reporters, software, statistics terms and gene FAMILY/complex names (AKT, MAPK, PI3K) are NOT entities. Relations are annotated only between annotated entities in the same sentence.

passages.text: Participants were recruited at three UK sites and BMI, HbA1c and LDL levels were recorded. The hazard ratio (HR) was 1.4 (95% CI 1.1 to 1.9) after adjusting for age and sex.
Total RNA was extracted, reverse transcribed and amplified by qPCR with SYBR Green. Samples were stored in DMSO at -80 degrees and sequenced on an NGS platform.
Cell lines from ATCC were grown in DMEM with FBS and imaged by FACS and MRI. Data are mean and SEM, with P values from a t test.
The ICU cohort included patients with COPD, HIV and CKD, and outcomes were assessed with ROC and AUC analysis. Missing data were handled by MICE in R.
Sequencing used the GRCh38 reference with BWA and GATK, and variants were annotated with VEP and gnomAD. Reads were aligned using STAR and counted in HTSeq.
Mice received IP injections of PBS or LPS, and IL-1 and TGF levels were measured by ELISA. Neurons were identified with NeuN and GFAP staining.
